visual_action: The video opens with footage of an extremely crowded airport baggage claim area. It then cuts to a montage of still photos of Chuck Schumer in various settings (a portrait, speaking, waving). In every photo, a colorful sombrero has been digitally added to his head. In one of the photos, Cory Booker is visible in the background.

cast.name: Charles Schumer

cast.name: Cory Booker

audio_music: The video is set to the song 'Anti-Hero' by Taylor Swift. The pop track plays throughout, with its lyrics used to create a mocking tone in conjunction with the visuals of Chuck Schumer.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a few quick shots of a crowded airport followed by a montage of still photos, with cuts and on-screen text timed to the music.
manipulation_or_satire: A colorful sombrero is digitally superimposed onto Chuck Schumer's head in every photo shown of him, serving to mock him.
cultural_references: The video is built around the song 'Anti-Hero' by Taylor Swift, specifically using the widely-memed lyrics 'It's me, hi, I'm the problem, it's me'.
central_claim: Chuck Schumer is the cause of the nation's problems, which are symbolized by a chaotic airport scene.
intended_effect: To mock Chuck Schumer and encourage viewers to blame him for national issues.
